title: Require self-identifying snapshot paths and preserve corrections as new immutable snapshots

decisions.rule: Every snapshot referenced by the index must contain a snapshot_path exactly equal to the index pointer. Never edit an existing historical snapshot to repair schema; create a new immutable correction snapshot, preserve the original, and retain the original data cutoff.
A structural API readback is not a Python validator pass. Record validator and gate evidence separately and only mark VERIFIED for the exact data-bearing head tested.
